_comment: Realistic road decal atlas (PLAN-VISUALS Track C). Generated by this repo, not downloaded: pipeline/make_road_decal_textures.py (fixed seed, deterministic) writes the PNGs, which are gitignored like the other content_src binaries. unreal/apply_road_materials_real.py imports them and builds M_RoadDecal_real. Also holds the downloaded ambientCG CC0 set(s) the Realistic road twins add (whole site CC0 1.0, no login; see https://ambientcg.com/about): fetched by `python content_src/textures/ground/download_ground_textures.py content_src/realistic/road/manifest.json` into <asset_id>/ (gitignored), imported by apply_road_materials_real.py.
